bibl.title: Two Christian Funerary Stelae in the Magazine at Fustât (Old Cairo).
bibl.seg: Amer El Mesiry & Lincoln Blumell, Two Christian Funerary Stelae in the Magazine at Fustât (Old Cairo).
bibl.note: Editions of two unpublished Christian funerary stelae from the storage magazine in Fustât (Old Cairo). One is written entirely in Coptic while the other is bilingual and is written in Greek and Coptic.
